items.content_html: This project is a lightweight browser-based interpreter designed for learning how code works. It supports two modes: execution, where programs run step by step, and explain-only, where code is analyzed and described line by line. Everything runs directly in the browser. Just open the app, write or paste your code, and explore how it works.

items.content_html: NAS Portal (aka OMV-Service-Dashboard) is a lightweight, self-hosted web dashboard for NAS systems and adjacent LAN services.
